description: YUP [1] reduces the nucleotide representation to a single bead located at the phosphorus atom P. This model relies on an energy function based on statistical potentials. YUP is utilized in Monte Carlo simulations for RNA folding, and - using experimental data regarding the molecule's secondary structure and tertiary constraints - it is employed in tertiary structure prediction [2].

inter_residue.description: Virtual bond connection from P (i) to P (i+1)
